message: 故きを温ね
After school, I hurry over to the Kujou residence... to see Helena-san.
Lately, the Demons have been getting tougher. No, if you just look at raw strength, one-on-one, we could probably still beat them back with our usual carefree attitude.
However, just like the Crusaders, the Demons have started helping each other out and launching coordinated attacks.
What can we do to hone our skills even further? First, let's try asking our senior, Helena-san.

name: Melilot
message: 「I shall take my leave now, Helena.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san?」
Practically passing right by me, Melilot-san steps out of the Kujou mansion. Judging by her parting words, it seems Helena-san is home.

name: Melilot
message: 「Good day. Do you have business with Helena?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes. There's something I wanted to consult her about.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Turning to her for advice is a fine choice.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think so too. Were you having afternoon tea with Helena-san, Melilot-san?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe, there was that as well, though I actually came by to repair a bookshelf.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Although the Kujou estate has many built-in bookshelves, every single one of them has started to deteriorate...」
As she says this, Melilot-san looks up at the imposing grandeur of the Kujou estate.
Built in either the Meiji or Taisho era, it's a Western-style mansion--what people apparently call modern architecture.
Every now and then, enthusiasts of that sort sneak onto the academy grounds to take unauthorized photos of the Kujou estate, only to get thrown out by the security guards.
If they're built-in, that means the bookshelves are from that era too... Amazing.

name: Melilot
message: 「Lately, there haven't been any artisans left who can repair them, so I end up being pressed into service. It's truly troublesome.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Melilot-san, you sound kind of happy about it, though?」

name: Melilot
message: 「D-D-D-D-Do I? That won't do at all; Helena will take advantage of me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, so books really have been treasured in the Kujou family after all. I had a feeling that might be the case when I saw the bookshelves in the chairwoman's office.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, it is just as you imagined. They are cherished more than any expensive piece of furniture.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is one of the reasons I am fond of Helena.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though they are merely rectangular objects, the meaning of the words inscribed on each and every page is truly too profound to ever fit inside those bookshelves...」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, books never show the slightest hint of such things, and simply wait patiently to be opened by someone's hands.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is something truly noble about that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「......? What is the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks to you, Melilot-san, my worries have been cleared up.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-I see, I am glad to hear that.」
That's right--isn't it way too early to beg Helena-san for instruction? Instead of half-heartedly wishing for a new special move, I need to refine the tactics I already have!

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, I shall return to the library.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll head to the Student Council room... to the old school building as well.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Fufu. In that case, we are going the same way for part of the trip.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」
Unbelievably, I walk side by side with Melilot-san.
It was a precious experience, though since the old school building is two doors down from the Kujou residence, it was over in the blink of an eye......
